# API Reference

Interactive OpenAPI UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs` · schema: `/openapi.json`.

All `/api/*` endpoints except `/api/public/*` and `/api/auth/login` require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`). Authorisation is enforced server-side per endpoint (see RBAC_MATRIX.md).
